dedupe_keys.name: statistics denmark register based dwelling tables bol101 to bol106 by municipality use tenure and year of construction statbank api

description: Statistics Denmark's Census of Housing is compiled each year by matching the Building and Dwelling Register (BBR) with the population register (CPR) through addresses, and is published in StatBank. The BOL tables count dwellings on 1 January for every municipality, region and the whole country: BOL101 splits dwellings by type of resident, use (detached houses and farmhouses, terraced or semi-detached houses, multi-dwelling houses, student hostels, community buildings, cottages, other), tenure, ownership and year of construction in 33 classes; BOL104 by household type and number of children; BOL106 gives dwellings and floor area by use; BOL201 to BOL204 count occupants; BOLRD gives occupied dwellings by tenure back to 1930. Annual series run from 2010 to 2026, and the tables were last updated on 8 April 2026. Format and access: the StatBank API returns table metadata and data as JSON, CSV, PX or Excel without registration; StatBank has a web interface in Danish and English. Licence: Statistics Denmark allows free commercial and non-commercial use with a source reference, which it states corresponds to CC BY 4.0. Caveats: counts are aggregated to municipalities, so building-level work needs the BBR itself; categories of use follow BBR codes. Simulation uses: municipal building stock by age and use for exposure and retrofit models, occupancy for population at risk. Related records: the Danish BBR building and dwelling register, the Statistics Denmark commuting table and the Austrian and Czech housing census records.
